question: Can reference-split local geometry predict disjoint holdout q?

external_pressure.pressure: 1-NN error is a classical estimator of local decision geometry, but the reference/test split matters.

external_pressure.source: Representation Geometry as a Diagnostic for Out-of-Distribution Robustness
external_pressure.pressure: Current work explicitly evaluates representation geometry as a diagnostic before target-domain labels.
Same-data performance estimates can be optimistic and need held-out or resampling controls.

answer_so_far.anti_tautology_read: Reference-field metrics are computed without holdout rows. All-row metrics and label-shuffle metrics are included as controls.
answer_so_far.next_required_test: Move from random held-out splits to temporal/checkpoint or natural-domain splits; the field must predict behavior before the target q is measured.
